producer_report.summary: A request that `athena plan` has read now stays in the plan and in drain's queue. Plan's `--budget` now only has to cover the reader cap, so the default `--budget 2` reads. Root cause 1: `steward::queued_work` listed only requests in state Queued, so a read request (Proposed) fell out of the plan, the next plan and drain. It now lists drained-channel requests that are Queued or Proposed, with a new `read` flag on `QueuedWork`. Declined, dispatched, blocked, closed and other-channel requests stay out. `RealSteps::queue` uses the flag and lists a job once when `approved_work` also lists it. Root cause 2: `Drain::prepare` always reserved read cap plus run cap (0.5 + 8.0 = 8.5 with athena.toml), so plan at 2.0 never read. `prepare` now takes the reserve as a parameter: drain passes read+run, plan passes read only. Docs updated: `queued_work` doc comment, drain.rs module text, README (rewrapped to the neighbouring ~110-column width, plus a new paragraph), CHANGELOG, and the `plan` help text in main.rs. Tests: new tests over real records and Stub, and the misnamed test is split in two (see criteria).

open_issues: crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs was edited (the `plan` help text) although it is not in the expected deliverables. It is a doc-string change only.

A request that was read and is still incomplete after its reading now stays in the queue (state Proposed) and is refused again on each plan or drain until it is corrected. I changed the note to say so. This follows from the new queue rule.
docs/decisions.md D104 still describes queued_work as unread only. I did not edit it because it is not a listed deliverable; it may need a note.
mistakes: My first draft of the drain-after-plan test counted Reader calls and expected two landings, and failed. A second identical job makes no change, and a failed job triggers a reader-role introspection. I rewrote it to count readings and cap max_jobs at 2.
I could not capture an output tail for the full `cargo test --locked` run.
learnings: `JobState::state()` is Dispatched as soon as the prediction commit (Job record) exists, so a test hook in `Scenario.during_verification` sees a genuinely running job.
`introspect_job` after a rejected or failed run makes a Reader-role call, so counting Reader invocations overstates readings; count `JobRecords.readings` instead.
The reader's deliverables get CHANGELOG.md added to a job's plan touches, so a read job's open questions can include extra paths.
`athena approve-work` jobs carry a request on the cli channel, so they appear in both approved_work and queued_work.
In this environment, bash accepts no pipes or tail, and tool-result files outside the working directory cannot be read.
desires: Bash allowing `tail` or reading saved tool output, so a command's output tail can be cited.
